summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; a concentrating creature it damages has Disadvantage on the Concentration save.
text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this dagger. When it damages a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has Disadvantage on the saving throw to keep its Concentration.
